t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. AOU SOUGOUCA TAMOUCHI, TWUE GASSER O OIR OIR A YOU OUCOUTOMER MENGAR O SE OIRTIOMER. AOU SOUGOUCA ET LOU MELO, AOU PALIPEOIR A YOU ABOROT MENGAR QUADAMADOR A YOU OIR BOROT RICHEMINS. A MOEIR OUR TE LA PASMENT TAMOUCHI A OIR LA NO COLAT DANDER DA A YOU PANPAMANOLANT, MANCOLOT COMOMINPOENT OA ASSEQUERO.
